questions: How to gate perf regressions soundly?

findings.detail: rust.yml triggers push+PR to main; github.event_name splits save vs gate.
run-over-run via actions/cache keyed by runner OS (rotating sha + prefix restore-key); restore into separate perf-baseline dir.
trimmed criterion high variance -> generous gross-regression threshold (ratio>=2.0); missing baseline skip-and-pass.
~40-line perf_gate.py (python3 on ubuntu) more controllable than critcmp, no cargo install.
